test_script.preconditions:
1. System Environment & Access:
- The validated test environment (QA/Validation instance) is deployed, operational, and matches the approved configuration specification.
- The application is accessible via the supported/qualified web browser(s) or client as defined in the test plan.
- A test user account is provisioned with the appropriate role and permissions required to access the graphing/visualization module (e.g., Analyst or Reviewer role).
- The test user has successfully authenticated and is logged into the system.

2. Test Data:
- A representative, pre-loaded dataset exists containing multiple distinct data points sufficient to render a graph (e.g., at least one complete series with varying X/Y values).
- Test data covers the different data types/parameters that the system is expected to visualize (e.g., numeric, time-series, categorical values).
- Edge-case datasets are available where applicable: a single data point, a large volume of data points, and a dataset with no/empty data to confirm expected behavior.
- Known expected values for each data point are documented to allow verification that the graph accurately reflects the underlying source data.

3. System State & Configuration:
- The visualization/graphing module is enabled, installed, and configured per the approved specification.
- Any required reference/master data, units of measure, and chart configuration settings are correctly configured and approved.
- The data source feeding the graph (database/table/dataset) is populated and in a stable, read-ready state (no in-progress data loads or locks).
- Display/resolution settings meet the minimum qualified requirements so graphs render fully and legibly.

4. Documentation & Prerequisites:
- Approved requirement specification, design specification, and this test script are available and under version/change control.
- Any dependent requirements or prerequisite test cases (e.g., successful login, data entry/import) have been executed and passed.
- Expected results, acceptance criteria, and the mapping of data points to graph elements are defined and approved prior to execution.

steps.action: Log in to the system with a valid user account and navigate to the data visualization/reporting module.
steps.expected_result: The data visualization module loads successfully and displays available data sets for graphing.

steps.action: Select a data set containing multiple data points and choose the option to generate a graph.
steps.expected_result: The system renders a graph visually displaying the selected data points with correctly plotted values, axes, and labels.

steps.action: Select a different data set with distinct data points and generate a graph.
steps.expected_result: The system renders a new graph that visually displays the different data points, accurately reflecting the new data set.

steps.action: Switch between the available graph types (e.g., line, bar) for the displayed data points, if supported.
steps.expected_result: The system updates the visual graph to the selected graph type while continuing to accurately represent the same data points.

steps.action: Verify the plotted graph values against the source data for each displayed data point.
steps.expected_result: Each plotted data point on the graph matches the corresponding value in the source data with no discrepancies.
